root_cause: Reconciliation used multiple autocommit SELECTs; an independent lifecycle WAL connection could commit between journal replay and projection comparison, creating a false corruption diagnostic.
negative_reproduction: Actual two WAL-backed SleeveReservations instances, original read cursor retained; writer reservation interleaved after journal SELECT. Two tests in .045s, one sleeve_projection_corruption error on valid committed state.
repair: RLock and own deferred read transaction only when caller has no transaction; original replay comparisons unchanged; rollback own read snapshot in finally. Existing mutation transaction remains caller-owned.
schema_compatibility: No schema, journal, epoch, reservation, position, sizing or economic rule changes.
coverage: Interleaved independent connection commit observes consistent original snapshot; next read sees committed reservation exactly
Interrupted existing mutation remains uncommitted and rolls back
Real projection corruption still fails and read snapshot closes
